decisions.reason: Active zero-day exploitation of Magento/Adobe Commerce affecting 160K+ sites; Rust-based backdoor deploying Linux backdoor via template injection. Belongs with existing StyleSmuggler story.

StyleSmuggler.evidence: Sansec observed first exploitation September 4 on fully patched target. Rust-based backdoor installs as kworker process with cron persistence. C2 disguised as NTP traffic.

decisions.reason: BigBear 2.0 PaaS framework bypassed MFA at 258 organizations, stealing 5K+ credentials via Evilginx2 AiTM proxy. Real campaign with documented scale.

Emergency MikroTik advisory for CVE-2026-67276 (CVSS 9.2) SSH auth bypass. Combined with CVE-2026-86060 enables full RouterOS takeover. Exploitation began September 2, patch released September 3.

CVE-2026-67276.evidence: CERT Polska confirmed active exploitation chain 'MikroTrick' since September 2, one day before patch. Attackers create admin accounts and modify device config.

CVE-2026-86060.evidence: Part of the MikroTrick attack chain combined with CVE-2026-67276 for full RouterOS device takeover. Confirmed in active attacks.
